component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for r = 0 to 5 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") for c = 0 to 9 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "R" + r.toStr() + " I" + c.toStr() end for end for rows = m.top.findNode("rows") rows.content = root rows.setFocus(true) end sub
' Play switches the list to floatingFocus, so the focus can rest on the bottom row. function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press and key = "play" m.top.findNode("rows").vertFocusAnimationStyle = "floatingFocus" print "PROBE|floating" return true end if return false end function
